notes: Probes: claude -p with --plugin-dir plugins/maeng-tools, one Agent call each, fresh --session-id, run from the repo root (prompt placed before the variadic --allowedTools). Totals add input, cache_creation and cache_read tokens of the first assistant usage record. The omitClaudeMd trial compares the CLAUDE.md block in the first request (present for standard, absent for design with the field); the baseline is a different definition, model and tool set, so the token totals of the two runs are not comparable. The sessions carried the user's global CLAUDE.md and a SubagentStart hook context; a first probe before the final definition edits measured 9744 tokens.
